scope: Source-method evidence only, lessons 02 and 05, v0.2.0 bounded trial.

source_pin.path: source-inspection/ch17/sources/Unit C Part B Mendelian Genetics .pptx

records.source_method: Begin with contrasting pea traits and absence of blending, then P/F1/F2 observations and the reappearing recessive phenotype question. Purple/white flowers are the historical entry; round/wrinkled seeds are the subsequent R/r worked model.
records.preserve: Generation relationships, model transition and question-driven progression.
records.qualification: True-breeding is a breeding-history/model premise, not an inference from one offspring. Technical testcross should not label every experimental cross. The slide 15 image supplies schematic fractions without experimental counts; expectation is not a finite-sample guarantee.

records.source_method: RR × rr yields Rr F1; F1 parents cross as Rr × Rr; grid edges represent gametes, cells combine parental contributions; segregation explains transmission.
records.preserve: R/r notation and contribution tracing. A purposeful simple grid remains close to explanation.
records.qualification: The complete-dominance phenotype does not erase r. Separation of homologues determines gamete contributions; random fertilization combines them. Slide 22 conflates these steps. Slide 23 needs the diploid/autosomal model scope. Do not turn this lesson into the full later grid algorithm or a meiosis course.

records.source_method: Dominance explains expression in F1; segregation explains alleles entering gametes. Slide 25 explicitly defers independent assortment to next topic.
records.preserve: Different explanatory jobs of the laws and later home for assortment.
records.qualification: Original image23 already scopes segregation to diploid organisms and assortment to alleles on different chromosomes. Complete dominance is the current expression model.

records.source_method: Ask whether one gene’s segregation influences another. Pure TTGG × ttgg parents yield TtGg F1, then TtGg × TtGg yields the 16-cell F2 grid and 9:3:3:1 grouping.
records.preserve: Actual T/G pea model, pure-parent to F1 to F2 bridge, one allele from each locus per gamete, and phenotype grouping.
records.qualification: Define loci and gametes before calculation. The original homozygous-parent grid repeats the same distinct gamete type. 9:3:3:1 depends on the stated expression and independent-assortment model. Necessary concept overlap is not a claim of blinded assessment.

records.source_method: Link independent segregation to alternative orientations of different homologous chromosome pairs. Recap image23 explicitly qualifies different chromosomes.
records.preserve: Physical explanation earns the equal gamete probabilities; explain the representation rather than naming stages alone.
records.qualification: Slide 41 refers to prior meiosis-II notes but explicitly places orientation at metaphase I. Its image44 includes downstream meiosis II; do not claim it makes the orientation occur in meiosis II. Four gamete combinations are across alternative alignments, not necessarily all from one no-crossover meiosis. Native A/B figure protection is outside this pass.

records.source_method: Worded parents → genotype/phenotype table → four versus two distinct gametes → eight-cell grid → four nonzero phenotype groups. Original parents RrTt × rrTt; gametes RT,Rt,rT,rt versus rT,rt; source answer order tall red/tall yellow/short red/short yellow is 3/8,3/8,1/8,1/8.
records.preserve: The smallest proposed structural adaptation can preserve tomato traits, R/r and T/t notation, genotype translation, asymmetric distinct gamete counts, eight equally weighted cells, six distinct genotypes, and phenotype interpretation.
records.qualification: RrTt × RRTt changes the second parent from yellow/tall to red/tall. It leaves only two nonzero phenotype classes; the four-group source demand and fruit-colour segregation are lost. Letter-only changes do not avoid an isomorphic protected answer. Do not present six genotypes as a new gain: the original also has six. Do not silently replace phenotype reasoning with a genotype-only target.

records.source_method: Parental phenotypes first constrain wwD_ × W_dd. Observed yellow/sphere offspring is wwdd, forcing a d allele from the yellow/disk parent and a w allele from the white/sphere parent. Thus wwDd × Wwdd; gametes wD/wd and Wd/wd; four cells then support expected counts.
records.preserve: The inverse inference must precede revealing full parental genotypes; it is the distinct purpose for keeping the case after forward tomato method. Retain both two-locus gamete construction and grouping/counting after inference.
records.qualification: The source 80-seed targets are 40 white and 20 yellow/sphere, pending concurrent protected-overlap review. Changing N can change copied count answers but cannot make the inference or 1:1:1:1 model structurally independent. Neither parent is a double heterozygote, so this case is not a test of two-locus independence. Correct fruit/flower drift and use expected counts with a clear counted population.

records.source_method: Practise simple one-/two-trait complete-dominance methods before additional complexity.
records.qualification: No linked video was opened. No reverse conditional weighting, selected-record denominator, linkage model, altered dominance system, or advanced probability agenda is justified merely to manufacture different answers.

adaptation_recommendation: Use RrTt × RRTt only as a documented structural compromise if preserving four-versus-two gametes and eight cells is the priority. It does not preserve the original four nonzero phenotype grouping demand; acknowledge that consequential source-method loss explicitly. No ordinary independent-assortment complete-dominance 4×2 alternative can preserve four nonzero groups while avoiding the original isomorphic probability structure. This source-method recommendation is not protected-task clearance or approval of a learner manuscript.
required_parent_resolution: Concurrent native/printed audit must resolve exact protected-target coverage and whether retaining squash values N=80 is permitted. This pass supplies method facts and conditional mathematical constraints, not that clearance.
